brief:
Israeli military forces demolished the home of citizen Nowal Abdullah in the Bab al-Marj area east of Deir Ballut village in Salfit this morning, the Ma'an news agency reported. Abdullah was photographed crying at the scene following the destruction.

The demolition left the family without shelter. The operation marks the latest in a series of home demolitions carried out by Israeli forces in Palestinian areas of the West Bank.
title: Israeli forces demolish home in Salfit village
